name: leanforge
description: Turn a software goal into an approved change contract, then implement and verify the change with evidence, remaining risks, and a user-owned integration choice.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a software goal into a verified change ready to integrate.
interface.longDescription: Leanforge asks only for user-owned decisions, turns them into an approved change contract, then implements and verifies the change with evidence, remaining risks, and a user-owned integration choice.
defaultPrompt: Use the installed $prime for an approval-ready change contract. Implementation verbs express the goal and do not bypass Prime.
Use the installed $run skill from the Leanforge plugin to implement and verify the approved change.
